Hi all,

Since the last three email threads about Dovetail 2.0 didn't quite land us anywhere, I thought it might be nice to try talking in actual real time. Just a thought.

Rough agenda:
- Where Lending and Member Services actually disagree on the account-opening flow (there are apparently two versions of the requirements, which is fun)
- Whether the compliance review happens before or after the pilot branch launch
- Who owns the fallback process if the core integration slips again

I'd really appreciate it if folks came having read the requirements doc this time. It's linked. It has been linked since March.

Thanks so much,
Maeve

---
